seo_title: AI Quote Follow-Up: Close More B2B Sales
seo_desc: Do you send quotes and they go cold due to lack of follow-up? We create AI Agents that contact your clients, resolve doubts, and close the sale for you.
author_pitch: As an AI Specialist, it frustrates me to see entrepreneurs, freelancers, and small businesses work hard to send a perfect quote and lose the sale simply because they didn't have time to follow up. Day-to-day work eats them up. I build AI Sales Agents that proactively contact your prospects in a natural way, resolve their doubts about the quote, and close the deal, multiplying your revenue without you having to chase anyone.
title: The quote graveyard: AI to automate your Sales Follow-up and close more deals
body:
Do you lose clients because you send the quote, dive into your day-to-day work, and completely forget to do the sales follow-up?

In small businesses, agencies, and freelance ventures, the owner is usually also the salesperson and the technician. You hold the meeting, prepare a detailed quote, send it... and there it stays. The prospect doesn't respond immediately and, due to lack of time or not wanting to seem "annoying", you never write to them again. That deal goes cold and the competition, who does insist, takes the contract. You are losing up to 40% of your annual revenue simply by not asking a basic question: "Do you have any questions about the proposal I sent?".

The trap of Robotic Email Sequences

To solve this, some entrepreneurs set up generic automatic reminders through their CRM. In the B2B sector, clients spot these canned emails instantly and delete them. Sending cold, contextless templates to try and close a multi-thousand-dollar sale is the fastest way to make your client lose interest and professional respect.

Our solution: AI Sales Follow-up Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we turn your sent proposals into signed contracts. We train an Artificial Intelligence Agent that acts as your personal sales assistant, analyzing the quote you just sent and performing hyper-personalized follow-up via WhatsApp or Email.

  1. Deep Understanding of the Offer: The AI reads your PDF before contacting the client, understanding exactly what services you have offered, the delivery times, and the payment terms.
  2. Natural Conversational Follow-up: The agent writes to the client days later with an approachable and human tone, tactically asking about specific aspects of the project to start the conversation without pressuring them.
  3. Live Objection Resolution: If the client replies that it "is a bit expensive" or asks if it "includes maintenance", the AI argues the value of your service and resolves the doubt based on your sales guidelines.
  4. Synchronization and Direct Closing: Once the prospect gives the green light, the machine sends them the payment link or the digital signature platform, notifying you only when the sale is won.

The Real Impact on your Sales and Revenue

  • Radical Increase in Closing Rate: By ensuring that 100% of your quotes receive the proper follow-up (3 to 5 touchpoints), your monthly sales skyrocket automatically.
  • Entrepreneur's Time Recovery: You stop feeling the anxiety of having to chase clients and recover dozens of hours to dedicate to executing projects and delivering great service.
  • Highly Professional Company Image: Your clients perceive an exquisite, fast, and persistent service, positioning your SME at the same level of customer care as a large company.
